title: NEXT F Privacy & Data Registry
description: Machine-readable data classification, field handling, retention, consent and privacy-operation metadata.

classifications.label: Public
classifications.description: Information intentionally eligible for unauthenticated public delivery under its owning contract.

classifications.label: Internal
classifications.description: Operational or configuration information that is not public but is not inherently personal or secret.

classifications.label: Personal
classifications.description: Information relating to or reasonably linkable to a person, visitor, customer, lead or staff principal.

classifications.label: Sensitive
classifications.description: Higher-risk personal, financial, authentication, transaction or operational information requiring restricted handling.

classifications.label: Secret
classifications.description: Credentials, tokens, signing material, encryption keys or equivalent values that must not be disclosed through public/runtime data flows.

qualifiers.label: Financial
qualifiers.description: Payment, refund, billing or transaction context.

qualifiers.label: Authentication
qualifiers.description: Identity, principal, session, authorization or credential context.

qualifiers.label: Tracking
qualifiers.description: Analytics, advertising, attribution, consent or visitor-observation context.

qualifiers.label: System Metadata
qualifiers.description: IDs, timestamps, status, diagnostics or other operational metadata.

eligibilityValues.label: Allowed
eligibilityValues.description: Allowed when the owning contract and authorization permit it.

eligibilityValues.label: Conditional
eligibilityValues.description: Allowed only after purpose, consent, authorization or destination-specific checks.

eligibilityValues.label: Redacted Only
eligibilityValues.description: Only a redacted/minimized representation may flow to this destination.

eligibilityValues.label: Prohibited
eligibilityValues.description: Must not flow to this destination.

retentionClasses.label: Ephemeral
retentionClasses.description: Short-lived request/session processing data; retain only as operationally necessary.

retentionClasses.label: Operational
retentionClasses.description: Routine operational data retained under the Site/organization retention policy.

retentionClasses.label: Customer/Business Record
retentionClasses.description: Business-purpose records such as submissions/leads retained according to customer policy and obligations.

retentionClasses.label: Consent History
retentionClasses.description: Consent evidence/history retained according to applicable policy and evidence needs.

retentionClasses.label: Financial Record
retentionClasses.description: Transaction/payment records retained according to financial/accounting/provider policy; raw card data remains prohibited.

retentionClasses.label: Security/Audit
retentionClasses.description: Security and audit evidence retained according to operational/security policy.

retentionClasses.label: Credential Lifecycle
retentionClasses.description: Credential references and lifecycle metadata retained only while required for the authorized integration/security lifecycle.

retentionClasses.label: Content Lifecycle
retentionClasses.description: Content and publishing data retained according to content lifecycle/version policy.

retentionClasses.label: Legal Hold
retentionClasses.description: Exceptional retention override only when an authorized legal/operational hold exists; not an automatic default.

redactionBehaviors.label: None
redactionBehaviors.description: No redaction needed within an authorized context.

redactionBehaviors.label: Mask
redactionBehaviors.description: Mask most of the value for display/diagnostics.

redactionBehaviors.label: Partial
redactionBehaviors.description: Expose only the contract-approved safe subset.

redactionBehaviors.label: Pseudonymize
redactionBehaviors.description: Replace direct identity with a bounded pseudonymous identifier; this is not automatically anonymous.

redactionBehaviors.label: Remove
redactionBehaviors.description: Omit the value entirely from the destination or output.

deletionBehaviors.label: Delete
deletionBehaviors.description: Delete when the governing operation/policy authorizes deletion.

deletionBehaviors.label: Anonymize
deletionBehaviors.description: Remove identifying linkage using the approved anonymization process.

deletionBehaviors.label: Retain Per Policy
deletionBehaviors.description: Retain according to the owning retention class/policy.

deletionBehaviors.label: Protected Retention
deletionBehaviors.description: Do not delete automatically because integrity/security/financial evidence may require retention.

deletionBehaviors.label: Review Required
deletionBehaviors.description: A human/policy decision is required before deletion or anonymization.

consentRelevance.label: None
consentRelevance.description: No consent gate is implied by this metadata; other lawful/business/security requirements may still apply.

consentRelevance.label: Business Purpose
consentRelevance.description: Collected/used for the requested business interaction such as a form submission or lead workflow; distinct from optional analytics consent.

consentRelevance.label: Analytics
consentRelevance.description: Subject to analytics/measurement consent rules where configured/applicable.

consentRelevance.label: Marketing
consentRelevance.description: Subject to marketing/advertising consent rules where configured/applicable.

consentRelevance.label: Functional
consentRelevance.description: Required for a requested functional service rather than optional analytics/marketing.

consentRelevance.label: Multiple
consentRelevance.description: Different fields/flows within the value may require different consent/purpose treatment.

exportSensitivity.label: Restricted
exportSensitivity.description: Export requires explicit authorization and appropriate minimization/audit.

exportSensitivity.label: Highly Restricted
exportSensitivity.description: Export is generally prohibited or requires exceptional privileged handling.

operations.label: Export
operations.description: Produce an authorized export of in-scope customer/personal data with classification-aware handling.

operations.label: Deletion Request
operations.description: Request deletion of eligible data subject to retention/integrity constraints.

operations.label: Anonymization Request
operations.description: Request anonymization when deletion is not the correct operation.

operations.label: Retention Expiration
operations.description: Represent policy-driven expiration without inventing legal durations.

operations.label: Legal Hold
operations.description: Represent an authorized hold that blocks normal deletion/expiration.

operations.label: Consent History
operations.description: Existing consent contracts provide evidence primitives; Phase 30 does not claim a complete request portal.

operations.label: Processing Record Reference
operations.description: Reference future processing-record evidence without embedding a legal-compliance engine in the Registry.

consentBoundaries.statement: Analytics/marketing consent and consent or acknowledgement for a requested form/business purpose are distinct concepts and must not be collapsed into one boolean.
Unknown optional analytics/marketing consent is not silently treated as granted.
Customer-controlled consent configuration does not disable mandatory security, fraud, integrity or transaction controls.
Tracking destinations evaluate the relevant consent category/state before optional dispatch.
Raw form payloads are not copied wholesale into analytics/advertising events.
Hashed or pseudonymized personal data is not automatically anonymous and remains classified according to linkability and purpose.
